terminalCodes.propagation: Profile/mapping propagate every reader terminal code. All three catches preserve arbitrary AppError codes (including DB, private binding or storage failures); a bounded fallback officer sentence is needed for codes not statically enumerable. Proposal-only disabled/unavailable/needs_input is unreachable for the approved-recipe large path, not silently treated as mapping closure.

stopRuleA.why: L3's one durable item job needs arbitrarily many successful yields/wake-ups across reader/profile/layout/mapping/pressure. Existing authority exposes claim/heartbeat/accept/cancel only, no yield/resume, and lifetime claim count is three. The owned jobs.ts hunk is registration only. Direct attempt/metadata rewrites would bypass this authority; distinct phase jobs would violate L3.
stopRuleA.needed: An authority-owned yield and transactional resume operation retaining monotonically increasing fences and distinguishing phase yields from failed attempts; queueIntakeLargeTx can then call it safely.
stopRuleA.buildDecision: Do not activate an incomplete automatic job. Finish independent projection/reasons/fingerprint/cut fold where sound, leave a checkpoint, and walk HTTP upload/register to its actual current stop.
